proposed_widenings.name: delegated_open_list_spell_cast
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main property does not grant a named spell. It chooses an arbitrary eligible Wizard spell at use time, then on success delegates resolution to that spell's own authored procedure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast...

proposed_widenings.name: activation_cost.uses_delegated_spell_casting_time
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activation cost is not a fixed action/bonus action/reaction. It inherits the chosen spell's normal casting time, which the current magic-item activation surface cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time...

proposed_widenings.name: activation_resource.spell_slot_of_chosen_spell_level
proposed_widenings.justification: The property consumes the user's own spell slot rather than an item use-count or charge pool.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check_gate.dc_plus_chosen_spell_level
proposed_widenings.justification: The Arcana check DC is dynamic and depends on the chosen spell's level; current ability_check_gate only carries a fixed numeric DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: make an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level)

notes: Did not author content JSON because the primary Unknown Spell property cannot be represented honestly with the current magic-item activation surface. Secondary mishap-table results add more surface pressure, including random delegated spell casts, object creation, and uncontrolled creature appearance. The Spellcasting Focus text is non-core support text rather than the blocking issue.
